description: Benign-divergence allowlist v1. Each entry reclassifies a matched finding to S4 and records the hit (a match is never silently dropped). An entry matches by exact `fingerprint` and/or a `match` subset of the dedupe key {fixture, scenario, signal, divergenceKind, semanticDimension, normalizedRootCauseHint}; at least one of `fingerprint`/`match` is required. Entry shape: { "id": string, "reason": string, "fingerprint"?: string, "match"?: Partial<dedupeKey> }. Entries are populated from a real run; this v1 ships intentionally empty.
